title: The Teenager Who Stayed Awake for 11 Days (Randy Gardner, 1963)
description:
In 1963 Randy Gardner, 17, stayed awake for 264 hours for the San Diego science fair, watched by Stanford sleep researcher William Dement. What happened to his body and mind — and why Guinness later stopped accepting sleep records.
Science story, not a challenge: never try this.
Sources: NPR (2017, 2024), Stanford's William C. Dement.
Animated with code, narration is synthetic.
